subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the released `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now through this doctor migration rather than implement a gRPC exporter?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but retiring a value shipped since `v2026.1.20` and accepting temporary telemetry disablement during upgrade require owner intent.

options.title: Retire with migration
options.body: Correct the compatibility provenance, then land the narrowed schema and doctor repair as the supported upgrade path.

options.title: Implement gRPC export
options.body: Preserve the existing configuration contract and defer this PR while a working gRPC exporter is built.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Continue accepting `grpc` without exporting, preserving configuration compatibility but retaining the existing foot-gun.

recommendation.title: Retire with migration
recommendation.body: Correct the compatibility provenance, then land the narrowed schema and doctor repair as the supported upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the diagnostics OTel configuration and runtime contract and is the strongest history-backed owner for its retirement.
